summary: All planned implementation items are present: PricingMetadata model with PRICING_MAX_AGE_DAYS constant and is_current freshness check; ProfilePricing model wired into WorkspaceProfile; service-layer workspace_pricing_metadata and compute_cost_estimate helpers; WorkspacePricingMetadataResponse schema added alongside existing LlmUsageSummaryResponse without modifying it; pricing field on WorkspaceResponse, WorkspaceOverviewResponse, and TaskResponse; pricing wired into workspace detail, list, overview, and task routes via workspace_response, _overview_pricing_metadata, and _pricing_from_workspace; console types (PricingMetadata interface, pricing field on WorkspaceOverview/Workspace), format helpers (formatCostWithPricing, pricingAvailabilityReason), and UsageSummaryBlock showing pricing badge, conditional cost column, and stale/unavailable explanation text. Test coverage spans all required cases: valid pricing parsing, missing/empty fields, stale detection, is_current, no-pricing-stanza returns None, compute_cost_estimate returns None for missing/stale/no-token cases, computes cost when valid, API responses include pricing null when unconfigured and full pricing when configured. Non-goals respected: no token-usage plumbing added, no DB migrations, no external billing calls, no hard-coded pricing tables, no lifecycle/monitor/merge-policy changes.
